about.description: OB Watersports offers pontoon boat rentals in Orange Beach, Alabama. They provide a fleet of well-maintained boats including luxury tritoons, family-friendly tritoons, pontoons with slides, and center console boats. All boats are U.S. Coast Guard inspected and approved. Located conveniently in the heart of Orange Beach, they offer full-day and half-day rentals for families and groups.
about.elevator_pitch: OB Watersports offers high-quality pontoon and tritoon boat rentals in Orange Beach, Alabama with excellent customer service and well-maintained vessels.
about.vibe: Family-friendly, professional, welcoming, relaxed water recreation experience
about.insider_tip: All rentals include a free Lily Pad Mat and 70QT Cooler with ice (Lily pad mats are limited and available while supplies last)

specials.name: Free Lily Pad Mat and 70QT Cooler with Ice
